character.name: Dr. Elena Vance
character.physicalDescription: 35-year-old woman with dark hair tied in a neat low bun
character.wardrobeDescription: a tailored silver-gray lab coat over a dark navy turtleneck

environment.settingDescription: a high-altitude glass observatory at night with rain streaks on the glass behind her
environment.lightingDescription: Soft cyan-white key light from top-left

shots.atomicAction: She slowly lifts a glowing cyan glass vial with her bare right hand from the steel table to eye level and inspects the swirling bioluminescent liquid.
shots.startPoseAnchor: Standing centered behind the brushed-steel console, right hand resting on the base of the glowing cyan glass vial on the table.
shots.endPoseAnchor: Holding the glowing cyan glass vial steady at chest-to-chin height in her bare right hand, looking calmly at the vial.
shots.directorNote: Keep tripod locked; do not cut early.

shots.atomicAction: She smoothly tilts the glowing cyan glass vial in her bare right hand and pours a steady laminar stream of glowing cyan liquid downward into a clear glass beaker on the brushed-steel console.
shots.startPoseAnchor: CONTINUATION FROM SHOT 1 END FRAME: Holding the glowing cyan glass vial at chest-to-chin height in her bare right hand above a clear glass beaker on the brushed-steel console.
shots.endPoseAnchor: The glowing cyan liquid settles calmly at the bottom of the glass beaker as she lowers the empty vial back toward the table.
